rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the Christian community or a local congregation, not the building itself.

example.english: Our church has a gathering every Sunday.
example.traditional: 我哋教會每個星期日都有聚會。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gaau3 wui6 mui5 go3 sing1 kei4 jat6 dou1 jau5 zeoi6 wui6

rows.note: Use this for the physical building where Christian services are held.

example.english: This church is beautiful, and tourists come to take photos all the time.
example.traditional: 呢座教堂好靚，成日都有遊客嚟影相。
example.jyutping: ni1 zo6 gaau3 tong4 hou2 leng3 seng4 jat6 dou1 jau5 jau4 haak3 lei4 jing2 soeng2

rows.note: Use this in Christian contexts for a worship service held at church.

example.english: We have church at ten this morning.
example.traditional: 我哋今朝十點開始崇拜。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 ziu1 sap6 dim2 hoi1 ci2 sung4 baai3

rows.note: Use this for a particular Christian denomination or branch rather than a local congregation.

example.english: They belong to a relatively conservative church denomination.
example.traditional: 佢哋屬於一個比較保守嘅教派。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 suk6 jyu1 jat1 go3 bei2 gaau3 bou2 sau2 ge3 gaau3 paai3
